SELECT
  rencana_tanggal AS data
FROM 
  perkara_court_calendar
WHERE 
  perkara_id = #perkara_id#
  AND (rencana_agenda LIKE '%perbaikan%' AND rencana_agenda NOT LIKE '%rekonvensi%')

UNION ALL

SELECT '' AS data
FROM DUAL
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
  SELECT 1
  FROM perkara_court_calendar
  WHERE 
    perkara_id = #perkara_id#
    AND (rencana_agenda LIKE '%perbaikan%' AND rencana_agenda NOT LIKE '%rekonvensi%')
);

lama.sql_query:

  rencana_tanggal AS data
FROM 
  perkara_court_calendar
WHERE 
  perkara_id = #perkara_id#
  AND rencana_agenda LIKE '%replik%'
  AND rencana_agenda NOT LIKE '%replik rekonvensi%'

UNION ALL

SELECT '' AS data
FROM DUAL
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
  SELECT 1
  FROM perkara_court_calendar
  WHERE 
    perkara_id = #perkara_id#
    AND rencana_agenda LIKE '%Perbaikan Gugatan%' OR  '%Perbaikan Permohonan%'
    AND rencana_agenda NOT LIKE '%Perbaikan Gugatan Rekonvensi%' OR  '%Perbaikan Permohonan Rekonvensi%'
);

sesudah.sql_query:
SELECT
  CASE DAYOFWEEK(DATE(rencana_tanggal))
    WHEN 1 THEN 'Minggu'
    WHEN 2 THEN 'Senin'
    WHEN 3 THEN 'Selasa'
    WHEN 4 THEN 'Rabu'
    WHEN 5 THEN 'Kamis'
    WHEN 6 THEN 'Jumat'
    WHEN 7 THEN 'Sabtu'
  END AS data
FROM 
  perkara_court_calendar
WHERE 
  perkara_id = #perkara_id#
  AND (rencana_agenda LIKE '%perbaikan%' AND rencana_agenda NOT LIKE '%rekonvensi%')

UNION ALL

SELECT '' AS data
FROM DUAL
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
  SELECT 1
  FROM perkara_court_calendar
  WHERE 
    perkara_id = #perkara_id#
    AND (rencana_agenda LIKE '%perbaikan%' AND rencana_agenda NOT LIKE '%rekonvensi%')
);
